description: Which data the app's PRE (its private test version) plays with. "own" (the default): its own users, saves, tables, inbox and community, empty at first and apart from the users'. "pro": the users' real data, read and written for real. Rooms are always pre's own, so testers never share a live room with users. Changing it signs out whoever is signed in to pre. Without "use", returns the current one. Switching to "pro" lets pre's unreleased code write the users' data: only when the developer asked for it.

use.description: Set it; omit to read it

name: neblla_pre_data
